QuestInfo.name: Family Heirloom
QuestInfo.0: Vieren says that the descendant of a great warrior in Sleepywood is keeping the last Augury as a family heirloom. Go find it.
QuestInfo.1: Ilji's older brother, Manji, knows the location of the Augury. Find him in Perion.
QuestInfo.2: Ilji's older brother, Manji, knows the location of the Augury. Find him in Perion.

0.0: They'll see. I'll be a great warrior, and... Huh? Who are you?\r\n#L0##bI seek someone who is undergoing a warrior's training.#l\n#k
0.1: The path of the warrior isn't for everyone. I'm the one you're looking for!\r\n#L0##bHmm... Perhaps. I seek a warrior who has a magical family heirloom.#l\n#k
0.2: Yeah, my family has one of those. At least, that's what my brother says.\r\n#L0##bI would see it.#l\n#k
0.3: Hm, I've never seen that treasure either. Why don't you ask Manji, my older brother?

no.0: Then I can't help you. Now, I better get back to training...

1.0: Hm? I didn't sense you coming... Who are you?\r\n#L0##bI am here on behalf of your younger brother.#l\n#k
1.1: Ilji sent you? I wonder if something's wrong in Sleepywood...

yes.0: Since Ilji sent you, I'll give you a listen.

npc.0: You're still here? Manji is in Perion.
